chapter: Growing up and learning in New Orleans
title: Childhood New Orleans: honky-tonks, blues, and Oliver's funeral band
summary: Asked about dreams as a kid, Armstrong describes the Storyville honky-tonks and tells of Joe Oliver's brass band breaking up a ball game on the way back from a funeral.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
